thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] latency-steering variance detected for routing policy 'latency-steer' between us-west2 <-> eu-west1. spike in 95th percentile and steering weight oscillation. severity=sev2. Pager: @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: ack. I'm on it. Observed increased p95 in hosted-api for a subset of customers. Paging # oncall-runbook.

raj_sre: digging in telemetry. I see steering weight flips ~every 18-25s for the last 7 minutes. Metrics: steer_score_us-west2: 0.7 -> 0.2 -> 0.75 repeating. That correlates with request spike and some 502s.

maria_net: +1. I noticed an automated autotune config (revisions/r345) applied at 08:12:07 UTC that reduces smoothing window to 5s. looks risky.

jason_prod: support: multiple customers reporting timeouts and 5xx. Most affected: AcmeCorp (api keys X-ACME) and BetaInc. pages from support increased 3x.

alice_oncall: estimate customer impact: critical endpoints experiencing increased latency and failure rate for ~10 minutes. will attempt temporary mitigation: pin traffic to stable region (us-west2) while we investigate.

raj_sre: recommended action: pin by policy override. Runbook snippet:

```
# pin routes to us-west2 for 30m
redwood routing override create --policy-id latency-steer --type pin --region us-west2 --duration 30m
```

I'll apply now.

maria_net: note: pin will update the control plane but DNS TTLs and edge caches may take up to 45s to converge. Also watch for downstream overload if we push too much to us-west2.

deploy-bot: executed routing override create --id=ovr-78945 --policy=latency-steer --region=us-west2 --duration=30m

alice_oncall: applied. monitoring: steering weight converging to us-west2. p95 trending down but still elevated.

raj_sre: follow-up: autotune change is the proximate cause — smoothing window too small causing reactive flips. Plan: revert smoothing to previous value and add rate-limiter to autotune updates.

maria_net: rolling revert of revision r345 -> r344 starting. CLI:

```
redwood config rollback --component=latency-autotune --to-revision r344
```

deploy-bot: rollback job queued, started.

sara_support: updating impacted customer list + Slack DM to account teams. drafting status page message. Customer-facing ETA for mitigation: 10-15m.

tim_pm: please capture timeline and action items. we'll need a post-incident to tune autotune thresholds and add test that prevents sub-30s smoothing windows.

raj_sre: logs after pin and rollback in progress show reduced oscillation. sample debug:

```
[08:18:12] steer->us-west2: 0.92
[08:18:32] steer->us-west2: 0.95
[08:18:52] steer->us-west2: 0.96
```

alice_oncall: p95 restored near normal for most customers, AcmeCorp reporting success. I'll keep pin for full 30m and monitor.

incident-bot: Status change: mitigation in progress. severity lowered to sev3. No active pager at this time.

maria_net: opened follow-up ticket INF-1253 to add autotune guard and add canary rollout for config changes.

alice_oncall: handing off to next oncall @raj_sre in 20m. I'll summarize: applied 30m pin to us-west2 (ovr-78945), rolled back autotune r345->r344, monitoring stable. watch for capacity in us-west2 and TTL fallout.

raj_sre: ack, taking handoff. will keep monitoring for 1 hour and then coordinate removal of pin once steering stable and smoothing window increased.

sara_support: sent customer updates and created incident note in CRM. will follow up with affected accounts.

incident-bot: [RESOLVE_CHECK] automated checks indicate p95 and error rates back within baseline for past 5 minutes. Recommend keep pin until postmortem and schedule config guard.

alice_oncall: marking this thread for postmortem. Thanks all. closing in 30m unless regressions.
